subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: After requester wake succeeds but required message-tool evidence is absent, should visible delivery fail terminally at once or remain separately retryable without invoking the requester again?
rationale: Current main retries the combined handoff, while this PR clears pending delivery after crediting requester wake. Choosing between immediate terminal failure and a separate visible-delivery retry obligation requires maintainer intent about user-visible delivery guarantees.

options.title: Retry visible delivery only
options.body: Credit requester wake once while retaining a bounded visible-delivery obligation that can retry and eventually enter the existing blocked or give-up path.

options.title: Approve terminal split
options.body: Credit requester wake once, immediately persist visible delivery as failed, and clear pending delivery without further attempts.

options.title: Unify failure recovery first
options.body: Pause this PR until its state machine is reconciled with the blocked-delivery recovery proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95080.

recommendation.title: Retry visible delivery only
recommendation.body: Credit requester wake once while retaining a bounded visible-delivery obligation that can retry and eventually enter the existing blocked or give-up path.
